notes.vehicle.stat_id: null for Classic Seasons rows: the launcher gives them the next free id at build; resolve the label with swofty::db at run time
notes.look.stat_id: Classic Seasons sets look stat ids explicitly (420-601), stock looks are stock ids
notes.filler: slot 11 in 2017-2025: the 2016 Manor car, drivers chosen at run time (DESIGN D7)
notes.logo_keys: Classic Seasons team logo keys present in every team logo and badge array it extends (tools/gen.py LOGO_ARRAYS); a season team's cs_team outside this list keeps its stock logo
notes.rating: Classic Seasons performance.json pace (2016-2024), stock_pace.json (2025-2026); null if none
notes.development: in-season pace of a real team relative to the year's car: checkpoints {at: 0..1 of the season, delta_pct: qualifying gap % minus the team's season mean, > 0 slower}; null without data (2026, the filler)
notes.changes: per year 2016-2025, the real mid-season line-up changes from the Jolpica race entries (data/rounds.json): from real round `round` (of `real_round_count`, at `circuit`, game track `track`) `in` races `seat` (team position) of career `slot` in place of `out`, with his real `number` and `look` (that team and year, else that team's nearest year, else his look that year); `until_round` when `out` gets the seat back, else `permanent`. kind: stand_in (`out` did not race meanwhile), move (`out` raced for another team), replace (`out` left). The season's line-up (`teams`) is the start; `calendar` lists the real rounds
notes.changes_skipped: real changes whose incoming driver is not in the game; the seat keeps its driver
notes.previous_standings: the previous year's final standings (data/standings.json, Jolpica): `slots` the career team slots in constructors' order, `drivers` the drivers in game labels; the season-start order of the career's standings
notes.ratings: per year, every driver of the season (line-up, stand-ins, mid-season changes): the base value of each driver statistic (`stats`: name, the game's stat_id and overall weight) and the overall rating they make, written into the career at each season's first Team HQ (tools/ratings.py: 2026 the stock 2026 dataset, 2025 the stock default = EA's F1 25 launch ratings, 2020-2024 EA's launch ratings of that season's game, 2016-2019 and drivers the launch tables leave out the model of tools/ratings_model.py; focus stock)
